name: scroll-area
title: Scroll Area
description: A native scroller with a thin themed overlay scrollbar that thickens under the pointer, and edge fades that appear only when there is more to scroll. Base UI Scroll Area underneath.
docs: Import ScrollArea from components/eased/scroll-area/scroll-area. Size it with className; give it an aria-label. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import.
